settings/enableFileLogging.title: File logging
settings/enableFileLogging.body: Write logs to /switch/akira/logs on the SD card. Required for retaining the subsystem logs below.

settings/debugLwipLog.title: lwIP log
settings/debugLwipLog.body: Include detailed VPN relay network-stack messages in the log.

settings/debugWireguardLog.title: WireGuard log
settings/debugWireguardLog.body: Include detailed WireGuard tunnel messages in the log.

settings/debugRenderLog.title: Render log
settings/debugRenderLog.body: Periodically log stream-view and render-state information.

settings/debugChiakiLog.title: chiaki log
settings/debugChiakiLog.body: Include detailed core Remote Play library messages while streaming.

settings/debugDiscoveryLog.title: Discovery log
settings/debugDiscoveryLog.body: Capture console discovery, subnet sweep, response, and wake activity.

settings/debugFfmpegLog.title: ffmpeg log
settings/debugFfmpegLog.body: Include FFmpeg decoder messages in the log.

settings/openDiscoveryLog.title: View discovery log
settings/openDiscoveryLog.body: View captured discovery activity, including other-subnet /24 sweeps and console responses. Enable Discovery log above to capture it.
